content.value_statement: Machine learning projects need consistent preprocessing, evaluation, and model selection patterns. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused scikit-learn guidance with references and examples.
actual_capabilities: Guides supervised classification and regression model setup with scikit-learn estimators.
Shows preprocessing, imputation, scaling, encoding, and feature engineering patterns.
Explains Pipeline, ColumnTransformer, FeatureUnion, and caching usage.
Provides evaluation metrics, cross-validation, grid search, random search, and validation curves.
Includes runnable classification and clustering example scripts.
Covers clustering, dimensionality reduction, and algorithm selection.
limitations: Focuses on classical machine learning, not deep learning frameworks.
Example scripts use built-in or synthetic datasets unless users adapt them.
Does not provide deployment, model serving, or monitoring infrastructure.
Some examples write local model files or plot images when run.

use_cases.title: Build a Baseline Classifier
use_cases.description: Create a train/test split, preprocessing pipeline, candidate models, and evaluation plan for a tabular classification task.

use_cases.title: Standardize ML Pipelines
use_cases.description: Use Pipeline and ColumnTransformer patterns to keep preprocessing, training, and validation consistent across experiments.

use_cases.title: Explore Customer Segments
use_cases.description: Compare clustering algorithms, choose metrics, and visualize groups with dimensionality reduction.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Classifier
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a basic scikit-learn classification pipeline for my tabular dataset. Include train/test split, preprocessing, and evaluation metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Candidate Models
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare several scikit-learn models for this problem: [describe dataset and target]. Recommend metrics and cross-validation strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Design Mixed Data Preprocessing
prompt_templates.scenario: Pipeline design for numeric and categorical data
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a mixed numeric and categorical preprocessing workflow with ColumnTransformer and Pipeline. Explain how to avoid data leakage.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Advanced Model Selection
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an advanced model selection plan with nested cross-validation, custom scoring, and hyperparameter tuning for [objective]. Include leakage checks and reporting guidance.

output_examples.input: I need to classify customer churn with numeric and categorical columns.
output_examples.output: A pipeline plan with split strategy, ColumnTransformer steps, candidate classifiers, scoring metrics, and validation checks.

output_examples.input: I want to find customer segments without labels.
output_examples.output: A clustering workflow with scaling, K selection, algorithm comparison, silhouette analysis, and PCA visualization guidance.

output_examples.input: My model performs well in validation but poorly on new data.
output_examples.output: A diagnostic checklist covering leakage, split strategy, metric choice, overfitting, feature drift, and simpler model alternatives.

best_practices: Keep preprocessing inside Pipeline or ColumnTransformer to reduce data leakage.
Use cross-validation and task-appropriate metrics before choosing a model.
Review generated file paths and model persistence steps before running examples.
anti_patterns: Fitting scalers or imputers on the full dataset before splitting.
Using accuracy alone for imbalanced classification problems.
Loading pickle or joblib model files from untrusted sources.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build scikit-learn workflows for preprocessing, supervised learning, clustering, evaluation, and tuning.

faq.question: Does it run training automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and example scripts. Users decide when to run or adapt the examples.

faq.question: Does it support both classification and regression?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers common supervised learning patterns, metrics, and model selection for both task types.

faq.question: Can it handle mixed numeric and categorical data?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains ColumnTransformer, imputation, scaling, encoding, and full Pipeline construction.

faq.question: Does it cover hyperparameter tuning?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes GridSearchCV, RandomizedSearchCV, validation curves, and related evaluation practices.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with private data?
faq.answer: The skill does not require external data sharing. Keep private data local and review scripts before execution.
